## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix one Important issue before merge: the new `--exclude` flag does not read its default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`, which breaks the project's CLI-flag rule. As a result, CI cannot set excludes through the environment.

## Changes
The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag. `collect` now skips files whose base name matches any of the patterns and logs each skip. The flag is documented in `docs/flags.md`, and the pull request adds tests plus a one-line text fixture.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the --exclude default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — Running with `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE='*.log'` set and no `--exclude` still archives `.log` files, because the flag uses `default=[]` and never reads the environment. Policy at `.agents/skills/cli-flags/reference.md:5` requires: "Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable". — CI jobs that set options through the environment cannot exclude files, which the project's flag policy exists to prevent. — Fix: Build the default from `os.environ.get("ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE")` split on a stated separator, document that separator in `docs/flags.md`, and add a test next to `test_exclude_defaults_to_nothing`.
